ModMetaData.name: Settlement Trade Overview
ModMetaData.author: Escarval
ModMetaData.description:
Settlement Trade Overview lets you inspect the current trade stock offered by world settlements before deciding where to send your caravan.
Open the trade overview main tab to browse settlements together, or select a settlement on the world map and choose View trade stock. Search, filter and sort offers, compare estimated prices, check distance and ground-route availability, and review restock and pawn trade details.
By default, a powered communications console is required on the current map or another player home map. Mod settings let you change this requirement and filter settlements by technology, distance, reachable routes and Royalty trade permission.
Use Refresh to read stock again. Reading stock can trigger RimWorld's normal stock generation; Refresh does not force an early restock. Displayed stock and restock times stay fixed until refreshed.
Purchases are not performed through Settlement Trade Overview and still use the normal RimWorld trading system.
Optional Xenogerm Planner integration can highlight genepacks for sale that contain genes useful for unfinished plans. Xenogerm Planner is not required for the normal trade overview.
No DLC is required. Harmony is not required.
Available in English, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, Latin American Spanish, and Simplified Chinese. Spanish translations by Annabelesca. Simplified Chinese translation by OPPO9008.
